newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NSW to sell Sydney Pacific Power building.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NSW to sell Sydney Pacific Power building.

text.p: The state government of New South Wales said on Monday it planned to sell the Pacific Power building on the corner of Park and Elizabeth streets in Sydney.
State Treasurer Michael Egan said the move was in line with the government's policy of divesting non-strategic properties.

The 42-storey office tower and single level retail area is 95 percent occupied by government agencies on leases of three to nine years. The building has net lettable area of about 37,435 square metres.
Knight Frank has been appointed agent for the sale.
